title: Facilitator in Microsoft Teams: what does the meeting agent do, and who can switch it off?
summary: Hold: a Copilot licence alone does not let every participant start Facilitator; Microsoft restricts the in-meeting switch to organisers and presenters using Teams for web or desktop. The open questions also imply that meeting memory is waiting for an admin switch, although Microsoft already documents one for its preview.

claims.claim: Allow or block Facilitator in Teams admin center under Teams apps > Manage apps > Facilitator > actions menu > Allow or Block.
claims.quote: In the left rail navigation, select Teams apps > Manage apps. ... Select Facilitator from the app list. ... In the actions menu, select Allow or Block.

claims.claim: Update-M365TeamsApp -Id <app id> -IsBlocked <boolean> changes the app's tenant state.
claims.quote: This cmdlet updates app state and app available values for the Microsoft Teams app. ... -Id <String> ... [-IsBlocked <Boolean>] ... The state of the app in the tenant.

claims.claim: The reference describes both its $true and $false IsBlocked examples as unblocking and does not reliably establish the blocking value.
claims.quote: Example 3 ... -IsBlocked $true ... Unblocks Bookings app ... Example 4 ... -IsBlocked $false ... Unblocks 1Page App

claims.claim: Facilitator retention policies are configured under Microsoft Purview portal > Data Lifecycle Management > Policies > Retention Policies.
claims.quote: navigate to Data Lifecycle Management > Policies > Retention Policies and create a retention policy
claims.fix: The path stops on the policy list. For a static policy, extend it to 'Data Lifecycle Management > Policies > Retention Policies > New retention policy > Choose the type of retention policy to create > Static > Choose locations to apply the policy > location > Decide if you want to retain content, delete it, or both'. Keep the note identifying Teams chats and OneDrive accounts; create separate policies for those locations. Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/create-retention-policies.
